operations.title: The quadratic Kummer eigenline has an index-two integral lattice
operations.body: Over K=Q(sqrt(2)), O_K=Z[sqrt(2)], the source Kummer generator is k=(-(2+sqrt(2))/2,1,0,0). A scalar a=m+n sqrt(2) makes a k integral exactly when m is even, so the integrality ideal is (sqrt(2)) and the primitive integral generator is kappa=sqrt(2) k. Multiplication by sqrt(2) has Smith invariants (1,2), giving O_K k/O_K kappa = F_2. Monodromy -1 preserves both lattices. Physical activation remains undefined.

operations.body: The checker verifies the integrality parity condition, ideal (sqrt(2)), determinant -2 and Smith invariants (1,2).
